title: Observational vs. Ablative Treatment for Low-grade Squamous Intraepithelial Lesions.
brief_summary: To evaluate the rate of regression and progression of low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion comparing expectant vs. ablative treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Low-Grade Squamous Intraepithelial Lesion by cervical cytology.
* Positive Biopsy for Low-Grade Squamous Intraepithelial Lesion after colposcopy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Serological detection of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
